job.title: Operations Planner
job.description:
Night boats leave Tanjong basin after the last commuter ferry.

Harbor Kiln Transit needs an operations planner for the inner berth.

Responsibilities
- Sit with the duty master each afternoon and write the barge order
- Recut the night plan when a kiln load is late from Jurong
- Own the weekly berth chart and the overtime roster for deck hands
- Walk the quay twice a week with the safety lead and log dark lamps

Requirements
Shift planning in a yard, a depot, or a small fleet. Spreadsheets are fine. A marine licence is useful. You should be able to explain a change to a coxswain without a slide deck. The team is eight people.

How to apply
Use the careers page and attach a one-page note on a night you rebuilt a plan after a delay. Interviews are on site at the basin office. Monthly pay is listed in the portal. The radio and the quay pass are issued on the first day. Cargo is kiln brick and bagged cement. The morning passenger run cannot slip, so the night plan has to finish before first light. You will also write the short note that goes to the port office when a slot moves, and you will keep a paper copy in the basin hut. Harbor Kiln Transit has run this berth for twelve years. The duty master starts at two in the afternoon. Bring boots.

job.title: Digital Collections Cataloguer

Dusty accession logs from the 1970s still sit in the mezzanine.

About the role
Pine Quay Archives is hiring a cataloguer to turn those pages into records a researcher can find without walking the stacks. You will photograph fragile ledgers under the copy stand, write a title and a date range for each volume, and attach the scan to the catalogue number.

What you will handle
- Parish newsletters and shipping lists from the old quay
- Flags for pages that need a conservator
- Two mornings a week on the reading-room desk

You will not rewrite history. You will describe what is in the box. We use a local Dublin Core profile and a spreadsheet for items the database cannot hold yet. Archives, a museum register, or a library special collection is enough. English is required. Malay or Tamil helps with the older parish files.

Apply
Mail a short sample record and a curriculum vitae to collections@pinequayarchives.example. The trust is small and the catalogue is public. The reading room is open Wednesday to Saturday. Researchers book a box two days ahead. You will fetch the box, stay in the room while it is used, and return it to the same shelf. Some weeks are quiet bench work only. Other weeks a school group walks through and you answer questions about the quay lists. Pine Quay Archives holds about four thousand volumes. The mezzanine is warm and the copy stand is already set up.

job.title: Signal Processing Engineer
job.description:
Hydrophone arrays in the tank generate more raw traces than the current bench can classify.

Tidewell Instruments needs a signal processing engineer for the recorder-to-board path.

Responsibilities
- Take traces from the recorder and write filters that keep the ping
- Drop the pump hum and hand a clean spectrogram to the acoustics lead
- Set the sample rate, mark bad channels, and keep a notebook of windows
- Move the same pipeline onto the small board in the field unit

The work is digital signal processing: FIR and IIR design, overlap-add, and a little beamforming when the array geometry allows it. Python and MATLAB are in use. C is welcome for the board. Three or more years on sonar, vibration, radar, or another sampled-sensor product is the bar.

How to apply
Mail a curriculum vitae and one plot you are proud of to careers@tidewellinstruments.example. Interviews are on site after a short phone screen. The office is in Tuas. Pay is a monthly salary in the portal range. The company issues the recorder and the board. A tank run starts the day. You set the sample rate, watch the channels, and stop the pump if a trace clips. In the afternoon you compare the board output to the bench and write down every window you tried. Tidewell Instruments sells the arrays to survey firms. A paper or a thesis on signal processing is useful. Parking is in the Tuas yard.
